# amended: 2026-09-09, the Phase 3 CHM/Properties union. 159 rows edited by hand,

# amended: 2026-09-10, the Class.getModule review. ONE row edited by
#   hand, not re-measured: bridge -> intrinsic, kind_stated 0 -> 1.
#   The gate's own header says the one-way half of it is adjudication and
#   that `kind_stated` may go 0 -> 1; this is that, for a row whose tag was
#   AMBIENT. `Class.getModule()` is not ACC_NATIVE -- its body is
#   `return module;` -- so a native in front of it is a 1.4 shadow by the
#   letter, and the letter's remedy cannot apply: java.lang.Class.module is
#   written by no Java code at all, only by a JVM at class-definition time.
#   Yielding returns null, which was 12 of the 108 failures under
#   The Intrinsic claim is SEMANTICS-PRESERVING and is earned by
#   31 byte-identical. The one deviation -- Module.getLayer() on the
#   UNNAMED module answers non-null where HotSpot answers null -- is a
#   defect in getLayer, is recorded, and is NOT frozen by this row: the
#   sweep is checked in and goes red when it is fixed or when this answer
#   drifts. Nothing else on java/lang/Module moves; this is one triple.
# amended: 2026-09-10, the Class.getName review. ONE row edited by hand,
#   Same clause and same shape as the getModule note above, with a worse
#   failure mode. `Class.getName()` is not ACC_NATIVE -- its body is
#   `String name = this.name; return name != null ? name : initClassName();`
#   -- so a native in front of it is a 1.4 shadow by the letter. The
#   letter's remedy cannot apply: `Class.name` is filled by a VM, and this
#   VM's mirror is not laid out like the JDK's Class. The registration has
#   said so since long before 1.4 existed: *"Override with native since
#   JDK's Class field layout differs from our mirror layout."*
#   Yielding does NOT answer null here. It answers the INTERNAL form:
#   which is worse than null because nothing throws, and it propagates into
#   every name comparison in the JDK. MEASURED: it is why
#   ServiceLoader.checkCaller failed with "module java.base does not declare
#   and the lookup asked for java/nio/file/spi/FileSystemProvider.
#   The Intrinsic claim is earned by apps/probes/ClassNameSweep.java, 24

#   2 after this tag. One tag repaired 22 rows because the JDK derives

#   survivor is Class.forName on a nested binary name, which is forName0
#   declining at a dispatch door -- and forName0 IS ACC_NATIVE, so 1.5
#   makes Bridge correct for it. Not frozen by this row.
#   `initClassName` stays BRIDGE deliberately: it is ACC_NATIVE in the
#   image, so 1.5 governs it and not 1.4. Two adjacent registrations, two
